news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire™ to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Claire, now live at LDS Hospital and American Fork Hospital under a systemwide agreement covering 34 hospitals and 400 clinics. This is the first real commercial placement since March's FDA PMA approval; the stock moved roughly +11% on the day.

news.headline: Perimeter Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call for August 20th
news.summary: Perimeter confirmed it will report Q2 2026 results after market close on Thursday, August 20, with a conference call and webcast at 5:00pm ET. This will be the first quarterly update covering commentary on the Intermountain Health launch and cash burn since the May/June financings.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital names Perimeter and maintains Profound as healthcare Top Picks
news.summary: Paradigm Capital initiated Perimeter as a healthcare Top Pick with a Speculative Buy and a C$0.95 price target (stock at C$0.275 on July 3). The analyst frames the March FDA approval of Claire as the accelerant for U.S. commercialization and flags M&A optionality, noting the stock trades at ~2.3x 2027e revenue versus ~10.3x average for comparable MedTech takeouts.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI to Participate in the Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented Perimeter's post-FDA commercialization strategy and upcoming milestones at the Planet MicroCap Showcase on June 17. The appearance underscores the push for broader small-cap investor visibility following Claire's approval.

news.headline: Perimeter Selected for INOVAIT Pilot Fund to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter secured up to ~C$148,000 from Canada's INOVAIT Pilot Fund plus C$100,000 in Mitacs funding to develop the next AI generation for Claire alongside the University of Toronto. The amount is small, but it is non-dilutive external validation of the AI platform.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Closes Final Tranche of Non-Brokered Private Placement
news.summary: Perimeter closed the final tranche of its convertible-debenture placement, bringing the total to C$6.04M. Insider alignment is strong: CEO Mendes subscribed C$2.76M and Chamath Palihapitiya's SC Master Holdings (Social Capital) C$2.78M, though the notes add potential dilution.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Perimeter reports Q2 2026 results after market close on August 20, with a call/webcast at 5:00pm ET. Watch for the first commentary on the Intermountain Health commercial launch, new placements from the ~50-lead funnel, and cash burn versus the May/June financings.

catalysts.label: Additional Claire hospital placements
catalysts.detail: With Intermountain Health now live as the first commercial deployment, the market is watching for additional U.S. hospital systems to sign on from Perimeter's pipeline of qualified leads in active Prospecting/Developing/Validating/Contracting stages.

catalysts.label: CMS reimbursement (Category III T-code / MEARIS NT-APC)
catalysts.detail: Management has said it is pursuing a CMS Category III T-code for intraoperative AI-enabled OCT margin assessment via the MEARIS NT-APC pathway (aided by Claire's Breakthrough Device Designation), targeting a January 1, 2027 effective date. This is a company target, not yet a confirmed CMS decision, and would be a major driver of Claire's U.S. adoption economics.

catalysts.label: Possible Nasdaq up-listing
catalysts.detail: Cited by Paradigm Capital as a potential catalyst to broaden U.S. investor access; no official timeline announced by the company.

pulse: The big development is Perimeter's first real commercial win: Intermountain Health went live with Claire in mid-August at two Utah hospitals under a systemwide agreement covering 34 hospitals, sending the stock up roughly 11% on the day and giving the post-FDA-approval commercialization story its first proof point. Attention now shifts to the August 20 Q2 report for evidence that more of the ~50-lead sales funnel is converting into paid placements, alongside management's push for a CMS Category III reimbursement code (targeting a January 2027 effective date) that would meaningfully improve Claire's adoption economics. Paradigm Capital's Speculative Buy/C$0.95 target (versus a spot price still in the C$0.25-0.30 range) keeps sentiment constructive, but the balance sheet remains thin and dependent on further financing, so this stays a high-risk, news-driven micro-cap.
